set -eu
cd /home/runner/workspace/ai-agent
node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
const root=process.cwd();
const file=(p)=>path.join(root,p);
const modulePath='backend/extension/3D_viewer.js';
const testPath='backend/extension/3D_viewer.test.js';
const source=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
const testSource=Buffer.from('','base64').toString('utf8');
if (!source.includes('Shared 3D workspace') || !source.includes('const SHELL_WAIT_MS = 4500')) throw Error('Invalid new 3D module');
const htmlPath='frontend/index.html',shellPath='frontend/shell-float.js',petPath='backend/extension/pet/limbo/pet.js';
const html=fs.readFileSync(file(htmlPath),'utf8');
const shell=fs.readFileSync(file(shellPath),'utf8');
const pet=fs.readFileSync(file(petPath),'utf8');
const oldTag='<script src="/extension/browser/3D_viewer.js" defer></script>';
const newTag='<script src="/extension/3D_viewer.js" defer></script>';
let newHtml=html.replace(new RegExp('\\s*<script src="/extension/browser/3D_viewer\\.js" defer></script>','g'),'');
if (!newHtml.includes(newTag)) {
  if (!newHtml.includes('</body>')) throw Error('index.html does not contain body closing tag');
  newHtml=newHtml.replace('</body>','  '+newTag+'\n</body>');
}
const oldShell='if (!panel || panel === root || !running) return;';
const newShell='if (!panel || panel === root || !running || window.Frontend3DViewer) return;';
if (!shell.includes(oldShell) && !shell.includes(newShell)) throw Error('Shell Float compatibility hook missing');
const newShellText=shell.includes(newShell)?shell:shell.replace(oldShell,newShell);
const oldPet='window.AICortexPetLimbo = Object.freeze({ spawnFrom, personality, findClearLanding, setAIControlActive, moveTo });';
const newPet='window.AICortexPetLimbo = Object.freeze({ spawnFrom, personality, findClearLanding, setAIControlActive, moveTo, isAIControlActive: () => aiControlActive });';
if (!pet.includes(oldPet) && !pet.includes(newPet)) throw Error('Pet compatibility hook missing');
const newPetText=pet.includes(newPet)?pet:pet.replace(oldPet,newPet);
for (const [name,data] of [[modulePath,source],[testPath,testSource]]) {
  if (fs.existsSync(file(name)) && fs.readFileSync(file(name),'utf8')!==data) throw Error(name+' has user changes; preserving file');
}
const temporary=[];
try {
  for (const [name,data] of [[modulePath,source],[testPath,testSource]]) {
    if (fs.existsSync(file(name))) continue;
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file(name)),{recursive:true});
    const temp=file(name)+'.3d-'+process.pid+'.js';
    fs.writeFileSync(temp,data,{flag:'wx'});
    temporary.push([temp,file(name)]);
    execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',temp],{stdio:'pipe'});
  }
  for (const [temp,dest] of temporary) fs.renameSync(temp,dest);
} finally {
  for (const [temp] of temporary) if (fs.existsSync(temp)) fs.unlinkSync(temp);
}
for (const [name,previous,next] of [[htmlPath,html,newHtml],[shellPath,shell,newShellText],[petPath,pet,newPetText]]) {
  if (previous!==next) fs.writeFileSync(file(name),next);
}
const oldPath='backend/extension/browser/3D_viewer.js';
let legacy='absent';
if (fs.existsSync(file(oldPath))) {
  const oldSource=fs.readFileSync(file(oldPath),'utf8');
  if (oldSource.includes('Browser 3D window stack') && oldSource.includes('const REDUCTIONS')) {
    fs.unlinkSync(file(oldPath));
    legacy='removed';
  } else legacy='preserved-unknown-file';
}
const testResult=execFileSync(process.execPath,['--test',file(testPath)],{encoding:'utf8',timeout:15000});
console.log('3D_WORKSPACE_INSTALL_OK',JSON.stringify({
 module:modulePath,bytes:Buffer.byteLength(source),test:'passed',
 htmlHook:fs.readFileSync(file(htmlPath),'utf8').includes(newTag),
 shellCompatible:fs.readFileSync(file(shellPath),'utf8').includes(newShell),
 petCompatible:fs.readFileSync(file(petPath),'utf8').includes(newPet),
 legacy
}));
console.log(testResult.slice(-700));
NODE
